src/linux/nativekit_gtk.cpp.notes: Clipboard and drop target negotiation, dialog lifecycle, standard paths, appearance detection, event mapping, GTK signal selection, scale handling, and WebKit error categorization are adapted to NativeKit's C ABI and event queue.

src/windows/nativekit_win.cpp.notes: Window class lifecycle, message handling, resize events, DPI behavior, COM file dialog options, and native message dialog behavior are adapted to NativeKit's handles, requests, and event queue.
